body.name: Fixed-dimensional certified empirical MOT procedure
body.construction: \(\mathsf{CertMOT}_\epsilon\) quantizes each empirical atom to a rational grid of mesh at most \(\epsilon/(8\sqrt d)\), solves the gridded dual by the ellipsoid method with a dynamic-programming separation oracle indexed by partial sums, lifts a primal coupling through quantization fibers, and returns the primal--dual bracket enlarged by the deterministic quantization error.
